versions.changelog:
No user-facing or functional changes in this version.  
- No file changes detected between versions.
- Version bumped from 0.1.1 with no updates to code or documentation.

Initial release of lista-wallet-connect with WalletConnect v2 support for EVM chains (Ethereum, BSC).

- Connect wallets via WalletConnect v2 and perform EVM signing and contract-call operations.
- Supports Ethereum (eip155:1) and BSC (eip155:56) chains.
- Provides a full CLI for pairing, signing, EIP-712, contract calls, session management, and diagnostics.
- Includes simulation by default for contract calls and enforces user consent before any signing or on-chain action.
- Adds OpenClaw streaming integration with robust QR/image fallback logic and user reminders.
- Designed for agent automation with machine-parseable outputs and concise user-facing summaries.
